jobs.title: AI Solution Engineering - Director
jobs.description:
About The Role

This is a senior leadership role within a central technology enablement team, responsible for shaping how AI solutions are designed at the earliest stages of major opportunities.

As an AI Solution Engineering, Architecture & Delivery Director
, you will lead a team of senior architects supporting high-impact AI opportunities across the firm. You'll translate complex business requirements into scalable, delivery-ready AI architectures, helping teams move faster by reducing rework, increasing reuse of proven solutions and ensuring designs are grounded in delivery reality from the outset.

You will act as a trusted technical leader, working with senior client and internal stakeholders to guide architectural decisions, challenge assumptions and build confidence in proposed solutions. Success in this role will be measured through improved solution quality, faster decision-making and stronger conversion from idea to delivery.

This is an opportunity to shape how AI solutions are conceived and delivered across a wide range of industries and use cases, driving both technical excellence and long-term business value.

What You'll Do

Lead and develop a high-performing team of senior AI solution architects.
Shape AI solutions at the earliest stages of opportunities to ensure they are scalable, secure and delivery-ready.
Define and embed standard AI architecture patterns and reference designs.
Drive the reuse of proven solution components, demonstrations and prototypes across teams.
Reduce the time taken to move from opportunity to validated technical solution.
Act as the senior technical authority in complex AI solution discussions.
Improve the quality, consistency and robustness of technical proposals and solution designs.
Partner closely with engineering and delivery leaders to ensure architectural designs align with implementation capability.
Engage with senior stakeholders to provide technical leadership, challenge assumptions and guide key architecture decisions.

This role is for you if you have

Proven experience leading solution architecture or technical delivery teams.
A strong background designing enterprise-scale AI and data-driven solutions.
Experience translating early-stage concepts into scalable technical architectures.
The ability to balance commercial urgency with sound architectural decision-making.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.
Confidence engaging with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience defining, implementing and enforcing architecture standards and best practices.
Strong collaboration skills across business, architecture and engineering teams.
A passion for helping organisations adopt AI solutions that are scalable, practical and deliver real business value.

What You’ll Receive From Us

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

jobs.title: Director, Solutions Architecture
jobs.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

How We Work

Coursera + Udemy lets you choose the best way to work, whether it’s from home, an office, or a collaboration space. We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to come together. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

Job Overview:

Within Professional Services, you'll lead the Solutions Architecture team through a fundamental change: from a technical intake team that passes integration work to third parties to a team that designs and builds the integrations we choose to own on Workato. You'll decide which integrations are strategic to own and which third parties can deliver faster, and you'll balance capacity across Coursera and Udemy technical work. You'll lay a foundation to build from, so that integrations are productized and reusable rather than one-offs, and you'll upskill the team to design, build, and test the way an engineering team does. You'll also take ownership of integrations built by third parties for both Coursera and Udemy, and decide what, if anything, to migrate in house. This is a highly operational role. You'll redesign how the team works with Product, Partnerships, Presales, and Customer Support, define workflows that are not yet defined, and build the delivery discipline, capacity model, and metrics that make the function run like a well-oiled machine. You'll report to the Senior Director of Professional Services and partner closely with the Director of AI Innovation to streamline how the team works.

Responsibilities:

Lead the shift from a technical intake team that routes work to third parties to a team that builds the integrations we choose to own, and set the criteria, service levels, and pricing for what we own versus what third parties deliver.
Own the integration roadmap and prioritization with Product, Partnerships, Engineering, and Support, and make capacity and load-balancing tradeoffs across Coursera and Udemy technical work.
Establish the Workato foundation and productize what we can, with shared standards and reusable components, and a custom layer on top that is easy to adapt. Build reuse into design review.
Take ownership of the inherited integrations, six years of third-party work on the Coursera platform and a handful on Udemy. Document them, decide what, if anything, to migrate, retire, or keep, and steward the code and its environment.
Hire and upskill the team to design, build, and test like engineers, aligned with Coursera Engineering's standards. Use AI-assisted development deliberately so the team builds fundamentals first, and manage token usage.
Redesign how the team works, including Jira, intake, and workflows with Product, Partnerships, Presales, and Support, and train Support to deflect development-related tickets.
Own the run and support model for what we build, including monitoring, maintenance, versioning, and service levels. Meet security, contractual, and data privacy standards, and serve as the senior escalation point for high-risk issues.
Partner with Presales on early scoping and own the technical handoff from Sales into delivery. Work with the Director of AI Innovation and Solutions on the pilot-to-PS transition review and on streamlining the team's work.
Run utilization and project tracking, manage the technical service catalog, pricing, SOWs, and margin, and build metrics that show impact on deal size, time to production, retention, and quality.

Basic Qualifications:

8+ years of experience in solutions architecture, technical professional services, or integration consulting, with a strong focus on API integrations (REST, SOAP, GraphQL) and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Proven experience leading and developing technical teams, ideally globally distributed, and running a technical delivery function, including capacity planning, utilization, and cross-team workflows.
Experience building reusable, productized integrations on an iPaaS platform and designing for reuse across customers.
Experience applying engineering standards (SDLC, design and code review, testing) to integration delivery, and coaching a team to adopt them.
Experience taking over third-party-built or inherited code and making build, buy, partner, and migrate decisions, including managing third-party partners.
Direct experience in pre-sales activity for technical services, including discovery, scoping, and SOW creation.
Strong communicator with stakeholders from engineers to executives. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

Hands-on experience with Workato, or a comparable iPaaS platform such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Jitterbit, or Tray.io.
Integration experience with SSO, ERP, HRIS, and LMS/LXP systems.
Experience integrating teams, codebases, or service portfolios through a merger or acquisition.
Proficiency in data analytics and SQL.

Compensation

Coursera offers competitive pay and fair compensation practices across all regions. Job titles may span multiple career levels, and the targeted hiring base salary range for this role in Canada is $175,000 - $218,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as experience, education, transferable skills, business needs, and location. This range may be adjusted over time and may include eligibility for variable pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

Posting Date
: November 19, 2026

Application Window:
December 7, 2026

We anticipate the application window will be open until December 7, 2026. Based on business needs, this opportunity may remain posted beyond or closed before the anticipated application window.

jobs.title: Sr. Director of ISV Business Development
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Senior Director, ISV Business Development is the global craft leader for Sage’s ISV ecosystem. You will act as the single accountable owner for turning solution strategy into ecosystem-led, commercially-governed growth. Operating as the head of the ISV craft, the role holds unified accountability for solution-strategy alignment, commercial contracting, go-to-market (GTM) success support, executive relationship management, and partner performance across every business unit, franchise and region.

This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Product Marketing, Growth, Enablement, Performance Marketing, Trading, Legal, Finance and Regional Revenue teams. It exists to ensure that the BUILD / Partner / Buy decision is made deliberately and consistently, that the resulting commercial relationships are contracted on scalable terms, and that partners are launched, supported and held to measurable annual targets – so that ecosystem investment is always tied directly to customer outcomes and revenue.

This is a Hybrid position based in-office 3 days per week.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Strategy Alignment (BUILD / Partner / Buy)

Own the partner voice in solution strategy – partner with Product Management and Product Marketing to bring clarity to the BUILD, Partner or Buy decision for each capability gap, ensuring the right capability reaches customers through the right commercial model.
Steward the Solution Maps – maintain the partner component of Sage’s global solution maps, translating identified capability gaps into a prioritized ecosystem investment and recruitment plan.
Guard the BUILD boundary – ensure that where Sage chooses to build, ISV extensibility, AI-gateway readiness and self-funding business-development principles are designed in, so partner strategy strengthens rather than duplicates the core roadmap.
Governance – run the quarterly connect / review cadence that keeps Product, Growth, Marketing, Enablement, Sales and Commercial Partner teams aligned to a single, consistent solution strategy across geographies.

Commercial Contracting

Chief commercial contracting authority for ISV – lead negotiation of global reseller, referral, OEM, white-label, marketplace, co-sell and strategic alliance agreements.
Scalable frameworks – develop and institutionalize standard commercial frameworks, pricing structures, revenue-share and API-monetization models, and policy standards that apply consistently across all Sage products and regions.
Cross-functional integrity – partner closely with Legal, Finance, Product and Operations to ensure commercial consistency, sound unit economics and end-to-end alignment to signed commitments.

GTM Success Support

Launch readiness – drive the five-phase activation lifecycle (approval and scope, commercial and systems readiness, product and technical readiness, GTM enablement and launch, post-GA performance management) so every partnership is commercially viable, technically sound and operationally ready before launch.
Enablement and handoff – ensure clean handoff to Commercial Operations, Enablement and field sellers (direct and channel), with playbooks, positioning and rules of engagement that let sellers support and position ISV solutions independently.
Field execution support – work with regional revenue and growth teams so strategic partners receive the visibility, overlay capacity and commercial guidance needed to convert strategy into pipeline and attach.

Relationship Management

Executive sponsorship – maintain trusted executive-level relationships and governance for Sage’s most strategic ISV partnerships, representing Sage as a senior partner in the market.
Joint business planning – develop and execute joint business plans, and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and executive steering committees with top ISV partners.
Final escalation point – act as the ultimate escalation owner for strategic partner matters, resolving complex commercial, product, legal and GTM issues and protecting long-term mutual growth.

Partner Performance – Annual Target Setting & Performance Reporting

Annual target setting – work with partners and regional revenue leaders to set annual ISV targets, ensuring ISV revenue is budgeted as an explicit subset of franchise revenue with assigned sales targets rather than left as unowned aspiration.
Performance reporting – own the ISV scorecard and regular reporting to leadership – tracking ISV-sourced and ISV-influenced ARR, net revenue and margin contribution, attach rate, retention/expansion, activation and churn.

Course correction – run monthly and quarterly performance reviews to track partners against target, and recommend investment, expansion or corrective action to keep the portfolio performing.

Qualifications:

Approximately 15+ years of relevant industry experience, particularly in ISV business development.
Proven experience leading people, beyond individual contributor success.
Leadership Approach: A “first among equals” leadership style, guiding four largely self-directed, director-level professionals.
Ability to act as a mentor, sounding board, and advisor rather than relying on detailed direction or hands-on management.
Leverages experience to provide guidance, anticipate challenges, and help the team navigate risks.

Plenty of perks:

100% paid premiums for health, dental, and vision coverage.
RRSP contribution match (100% up to 4%).
35 days paid time off (11 paid holidays, 16 vacation days, 3 personal days, 5 sick days).
18 weeks of paid parental leave for birth, adoption, or surrogacy offered 1 year after the start date.
5 days paid yearly to volunteer (through Sage Foundation).
$5,250 tuition reimbursement per calendar year, starting 6 months after the hire date.
Sage Wellness Rewards Program (annual fitness reimbursement).
Library of on-demand career development options and ongoing training offerings.

Who is Sage: https://www.sage.com/en-us/company/about-sage/

Life at Sage: https://www.sage.com/en-us/company/careers/

Our Values & Behaviors: https://www.youtube.com/watch app=desktop&v=vt5JXfGwno&feature=youtu.be

The compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, education, and experience. For this role, in these locations, the base salary range for new hires is: $185,000 to $235,000 plus bonus.

In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either a bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, commission plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. The range listed is just one component of the Sage total compensation package.

You'll turn Adobe's go-to-market strategy, solutions portfolio (including Adobe Experience Cloud) and partner ecosystem into a compelling, scalable PwC market proposition, and deliver measurable revenue growth as a result.

This is a senior, high-impact role where your results will be visible and your influence will be real. With clear accountability for materially growing Adobe-related revenue across the UK, you'll operate at C-suite level, both within PwC and with Adobe, navigating a highly matrixed alliance environment with confidence. You'll be at the heart of building pipeline, increasing win rates, strengthening senior client relationships and championing Adobe-led solutions across the firm. Working closely with PwC practice teams, network firms and Adobe leadership, you'll own alliance performance end to end, from pipeline creation, revenue growth and sales conversion to team effectiveness and investment priorities.

What Your Days Will Look Like

Leading Go-To-Market Strategy
Shape and deliver the Adobe alliance strategy to drive market growth and revenue
Build pipeline and speed up deals with sales, delivery and Adobe teams
Develop joint solutions and build Adobe propositions into wider transformation programmes

Lead joint planning, keep accreditations current and secure investment for Adobe opportunities
Driving Revenue Growth
Own year-on-year growth in Adobe-related pipeline and revenue
Find and win "sell-with" opportunities with Adobe, and lead the plans to win priority deals
Manage the commercial side of the partnership, including funding, referrals and joint investment
Drive demand and joint marketing campaigns, and keep forecasting and pipeline tracking on course
Work directly with clients on presentations, proposals, Statements of Work and commercial structuring
Build client success stories and case studies
Operational Leadership & Governance
Oversee how the Adobe alliance plan is carried out across the firm
Track and report progress, and step in early when risks could affect revenue
Report on key measures: pipeline, revenue, win rates and funding use
Own the Adobe relationship map across stakeholders
Manage the alliance budget and make sure resources go where they're needed most
Make sure contracts, commercial agreements and governance requirements are in place and followed

This Role Is For You If

You bring a proven, personal track record of tech sales leadership at a leading SaaS, CRM or technology company, such as Google, Salesforce, Microsoft or similar
You have strong experience selling marketing technology (MarTech) solutions, ideally across platforms such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or similar
You're a confident communicator and an inspiring leader

You motivate the people around you and adapt quickly when priorities shift

You're a skilled influencer, negotiator and facilitator who brings people together to get deals done
You're naturally curious and stay ahead of emerging industry trends
You're comfortable operating at C-suite level, and ready to challenge both internal leaders and Adobe counterparts to unlock growth
You thrive in ambiguity and are energised by building momentum where none exists

jobs.title: VP, Engineering Operations
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

Why would you love this job?

Engineering Operations is a high-leverage function within the CTO organization. Its purpose is to make Engineering and Cloud Operations execution legible, commitments durable, and leadership time scalable—primarily through clarity, technical depth, and strategic influence.

As VP, Engineering Operations, you will build and evolve the operating system of the CTO organization while steering the AI transformation of our engineering and cloud infrastructure operations. You will work across Engineering, Cloud Ops, and product partners to create confidence in delivery, surface technical risks early, drive modern AI-enabled engineering workflows, and empower leaders to focus on long-term strategy and architectural outcomes.

This is a highly visible role for a deeply technical operator who can move comfortably between software architecture, cloud platforms, AI-driven automation, data, and organizational dynamics. You will succeed not by adding bureaucracy, but by introducing intelligent, modern structures for better architectural decisions, clear ownership, and scalable execution.

What You’ll Do

Own the Engineering operating system

Design, run, and continuously improve the CTO organization’s operating cadence, including quarterly business reviews, initiative and program reviews, goal-setting cycles, leadership forums, and internal communications.
Establish lightweight, reusable standards for agendas, pre-reads, synthesis, status, risk and confidence language, ownership, dependencies, decision capture, and follow-through.
Turn fragmented execution signals into concise, decision-ready narratives for the CTO and Engineering leadership.
Ensure forums drive decisions and tradeoffs—not simply status updates.

Create execution visibility and confidence

Make Engineering priorities, commitments, dependencies, and risks visible across the company.
Improve the quality and timeliness of early risk detection and escalation.
Use data and qualitative signals together to distinguish real progress from activity or optimism.

Align priorities, people, and investment

Partner with the CTO, Engineering leaders, Finance, People, Product, and other functions to connect strategy, priorities, capacity, headcount, funding, and operating norms.
Support workforce and headcount planning, financial and investment alignment, and organizational planning with clear analysis and decision materials.
Improve cross-geo and cross-functional operating norms so expectations are explicit rather than assumed.

Provide leverage on strategic and special initiatives

Bring structure to ambiguous, cross-cutting, or high-risk initiatives that do not yet have a natural program home.
Support high-impact company priorities such as major transformations, IPO readiness, M&A diligence, or other initiatives requiring CTO-level coordination.
Know when to stay involved, when to escalate, and when to exit so Engineering Operations does not become a permanent dependency.

Build durable operating muscle

Institutionalize good judgment into reusable systems, templates, and standards.
Use automation, analytics, and AI-assisted workflows thoughtfully to improve signal quality and operating leverage.
Socialize changes effectively and build adoption through clarity, usefulness, and trust—not compliance theater.

Drive AI Transformation in Engineering and Cloud Operations

Architect and execute strategic initiatives that integrate AI technologies into software development lifecycles, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations to accelerate innovation and developer efficiency.
Establish frameworks and benchmarks to evaluate the adoption, effectiveness, and impact of AI tools across engineering and cloud infrastructure teams.
Lead cross-functional programs focused on automated observability, AI-driven incident management, and intelligent cloud resource optimization.

What will you need to have?

Deep technical background in software engineering, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure operations alongside experience in a strategic leadership or business operations role.
A demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous, cross-functional problems into clear decisions, ownership, operating mechanisms, and measurable outcomes.
Experience designing and running operating cadences, business reviews, planning processes, leadership forums, or comparable mechanisms that improve execution.
The ability to influence without relying on formal authority and to build trust across geographies, functions, and levels of the organization.
Comfort working in a fast-changing environment with incomplete information and competing priorities.

Extra Great If You Have

Experience supporting a CTO, VP Engineering, or comparable technology executive in a high-growth or transformation environment.
Experience with annual planning, portfolio management, headcount planning, financial modeling, or investment reviews.
Experience supporting IPO readiness, M&A diligence, organizational transformation, or other enterprise-scale change.
Experience building operating standards, metrics, dashboards, or lightweight automation that materially improves decision quality.
Hands-on experience designing or deploying AI tooling, LLM integrations, AI-assisted coding, or automated ops platforms within large-scale engineering or cloud environments.

We Give Back To Our Employees

Our culture is what makes Redis a fun and rewarding place to work. To support you at work and beyond, we offer all our US team members fantastic benefits and perks:

Competitive salaries and equity grants
Unlimited time off to promote a healthy work-life balance
H/D/V coverage along with 401K, FSA, and commuter benefits
Frequent team celebrations and recreation events
Home internet & phone stipend
Learning and development opportunities
Ability to influence a high-performance company on its way to IPO

The estimated gross base annual salary range for this role is $275,000 - 3000,000 per year in New York, California, Washington, Colorado, and Rhode Island. Actual compensation may vary and is dependent on various factors, including a candidate’s work location, qualifications, experience, and competencies. Base annual salary is one component of Redis’ total compensation and competitive benefits package, which may include 401(k), unlimited time off, learning and development opportunities, and comprehensive health and wellness benefits. This role may include discretionary bonuses, stock options, commuter benefits based on location, or a commission plan. Salary history is not used in compensation package decisions. Redis utilizes market pay data to determine compensation, so posted compensation ranges are subject to change as new market data becomes available.

As a global company, we value a culture of curiosity, diversity of thought, and innovation from our employees, customers, and partners. Redis is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment where all employees’ differences are celebrated and supported, and everyone feels safe to bring their authentic selves to work. Redis is dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, Veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard, and every idea is respected.

Redis is committed to working with and providing access and reasonable accommodation to applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require accommodations for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to recruiting@redis.com. Any offer of employment at Redis is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable laws.

jobs.title: Director, Developer Success Programs
jobs.description:
About Docker

Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. Docker Hardened Images form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud Docker Sandboxes isolate where agents run, and Docker AI Governance sets enterprise-wide policy. Together, they give builders and organizations the confidence to adopt any model, tool, or agent without compromising security, governance, or control.

_______________________________________________________________________

The Role

The Director, Developer Success Engineering leads the technical half of Docker's Developer Success team: the senior engineers who build the demos, Labspaces, workshops, tech talks and technical content that show developers what Docker can do. This role gives that team a leader who can go deep on the technology, raise the bar on technical quality, and grow senior engineers in their careers. It owns three outcomes:

Own Docker's technical story for developers. Demos, Labspaces, reference applications and content that make AI Governance, Sandboxes, Docker Hardened Images and the core Docker experience easy to understand and adopt.
Turn technical content into adoption and revenue. Equip customer-facing teams, Captains and partners with enablement that lands and expands accounts, and measure its impact.
Be the developer's voice inside Docker. Bring hands-on feedback from developers, Captains and customers back to Product and Engineering so it shapes what Docker builds.

You will be part of the DevRel team's mission for Docker to become the destination where current and future developers improve their craft, get support and find their community home. You report to the VP of Developer Success (DevRel & Docs) and lead a team of four staff and principal engineers. You work side by side with the Director, Developer Success Programmes, whose team runs the community, Captain, influencer and partner programmes your team's technical work powers.

You'll be successful if you are an engineer at heart who loves building and explaining technology, and who wants to multiply that impact through a team. The FY27 centre of gravity is product adoption and revenue enablement, not awareness metrics alone.

_______________________________________________________________________

Responsibilities

Own Docker's technical story for developers

Set the technical content strategy for Developer Success, aligned with Docker's product priorities: agentic development with Sandboxes, AI Governance, Docker Hardened Images and the core Docker experience.
Own the developer-facing product narrative for Captain briefings and launches, so the team delivers most briefings and demos itself rather than relying on ad hoc presenters.
Lead the Labspaces catalogue as Docker's reusable demo and learning format: every strategic demo, briefing, talk and workshop is packaged once and reused across Captains, revenue, partners, events and Docs.
Set technical quality standards for demos, code samples, reference apps and tutorials, including how they are tested, kept current with fast-moving products, and retired.
Partner with Docs on hands-on learning content on docs.docker.com, including the Learn experience.

Turn technical content into adoption and revenue

Scale the technical enablement content for customer-facing teams: tech talks, Docker Days, SDLC demos and workshops, prioritised with Revenue leadership on a regular cadence.
Equip Solutions Engineers, Professional Services, Captains and partners to deliver Docker's story themselves, with kits that cut their demo preparation time.
Track the impact of technical enablement on product adoption, pipeline and expansion ARR, and report it alongside the programmes team.
Bring the team's technical depth to tier-1 events, partner work and the community programmes run by the Developer Success Programmes team.

Be the developer's voice inside Docker

Build structured feedback loops from developers, Captains and customers into Product and Engineering, including pre-launch reviews of new features.
Test new products early, report friction in the developer experience, and follow it through to fixes.
Represent Docker credibly in technical forums: conference talks, open source communities, technical blogs and developer communities.

Lead the team

Lead and grow a team of senior developer advocates and engineers: set clear goals, give technical and career coaching, and build growth paths for senior individual contributors.
Balance the team's capacity between strategic content, revenue enablement and inbound requests through a clear intake and prioritisation process.
Hire to fill capability gaps as Docker's product portfolio grows.

_______________________________________________________________________

Qualifications

A software engineering background, with deep hands-on knowledge of containers, Docker and modern developer workflows. You can build and debug a demo yourself.
Working knowledge of AI and agentic development (LLMs, agents, MCP) and of software supply chain security. Experience in either is a strong plus.
Experience leading a team of senior engineers, developer advocates or solutions engineers, and a track record of growing senior individual contributors.
A strong technical public presence: conference talks, workshops, technical writing or open source contributions.
Experience building technical enablement for sales, solutions or customer success teams, and tying it to adoption or revenue outcomes.
Ability to build trusted relationships with Product and Engineering leaders, and to influence roadmaps with evidence from developers.
Analytical and data-driven in how you prioritise and measure technical content and programmes.
Able to coordinate across many teams and perform in a fast-moving environment; self-directed, self-driven and able to prioritise strongly.
Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

_______________________________________________________________________

What To Expect

First 30 days

Get to know each team member, their technical focus areas, current work and career goals.
Get hands-on with Docker's products, especially Sandboxes, AI Governance and Docker Hardened Images, and run the team's top Labspaces and demos yourself.
Meet key stakeholders in Product, Engineering, Revenue, Professional Services, Docs and the Developer Success Programmes team, and learn what they need from technical Developer Success.
Live the Docker culture: humility, developer obsession, open collaboration and a bias for considered action.

First 90 days

Set the team's technical content and enablement roadmap for the next two quarters, tied to product priorities and launch cadence.
Put in place an intake and prioritisation process with Revenue and Product so the team's capacity goes to the highest-impact work.
Agree the measures that link the team's work to adoption and revenue, such as Labspace usage by account and ARR influenced by tech talks.
Become a trusted technical partner to Product, Engineering and marketing leadership.

First year

Deliver a consistent, current catalogue of demos, Labspaces and talks that tells Docker's story across AI, security and developer productivity.
Show a measurable link from technical enablement to product adoption and expansion revenue.
Establish a regular feedback channel from developers and Captains that visibly influences Docker's product roadmap.
Grow a team of senior engineers and advocates with clear career paths, recognised internally and externally for technical excellence.

Job Description

Director, Finance Systems

Plusgrade is scaling across global entities and building toward public-company readiness, and our Finance systems need an architect who can turn complex accounting and control requirements into clean, automated infrastructure. If you want to own the Finance-side design of NetSuite and our broader financial tech stack from the ground up rather than maintain someone else's legacy setup, this seat is yours.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead current- and future-state Finance process design with domain leaders, applying modern, best-fit technology to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and accelerate cycle times. Translate needs into requirements and control criteria; define and track value and outcomes for related system, integration, and automation changes, including AI use cases.
Partner with the VP, Finance Technology & Automation and Finance leaders on roadmap and prioritization. Lead Finance-side discovery, process and control design, and initiative coordination.
Lead Finance-side evaluation and implementation of NetSuite and related platforms. Partner with the Director, Finance Automation and technical teams on architecture, integrations, configuration, testing, and launch; validate process and control fit and audit readiness before go-live.
Define Finance needs for data quality, reconciliations, and reporting; partner with technical and data teams to ensure Finance data flows are complete, reliable, and audit-ready.
Partner with application specialists and technical owners to maintain operational readiness for Finance systems, including user support, documentation, adoption, escalation paths, incident coordination, releases, and upgrades.
Lead, develop, and coach the team, setting clear expectations and building the capabilities needed to deliver Finance systems initiatives.
Set control requirements for finance systems and processes affecting financial reporting, including data integrity, access, segregation of duties, approvals, and change management. Partner with IT on SOX, ITGC, ICFR, and ITACs.
Lead audit readiness for Finance systems and application controls; coordinate evidence and track remediation with control owners, IT, and Finance to support public-company readiness.
Coordinate Finance-facing vendor relationships, including service reviews, escalations, and renewal or change recommendations.

What You Bring

10+ years of progressive experience in finance systems, enterprise applications, or a related field, including at least 5 years leading teams or major programs.
A track record of leading Finance-side requirements, process design, controls, and adoption for ERP implementations or transformations. NetSuite experience is strongly preferred, including partnering with technical owners on configuration, integrations, and change governance.
A bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business, or a related field; CPA or equivalent accounting designation is preferred.
Experience supporting global, multi-entity environments, ideally including M&A or business integrations.
Experience supporting a public company or pre-IPO environment is preferred.
Strong knowledge of Finance processes, accounting operations, financial reporting, and internal controls, including SOX/ITGC/ICFR, IT application controls (ITACs), and segregation-of-duties concepts; able to translate these into practical process and system requirements.
Experience with integrations, data architecture and governance, system security, and process automation. EPM, BI, or data-warehouse experience is an asset.
Clear communication and sound initiative leadership—you can facilitate process design with Finance leaders, define success measures and control requirements, influence across functions, and partner effectively with technical teams while balancing strategic direction with practical execution.
Experience evaluating or implementing AI-enabled solutions in Finance or Accounting workflows—such as transaction matching, reconciliations, invoice processing, close, reporting, or anomaly detection—with appropriate human review, data privacy, auditability, and control safeguards is an asset.

Why Plusgrade

Travel is about the moments that make a journey feel personal. At Plusgrade, we build the technology that makes those moments possible, from upgrade offers and loyalty experiences to revenue tools used by 575+ airline, hospitality, cruise, rail, and financial services partners worldwide.

The work is global, complex, and rewarding. You will solve meaningful problems, take ownership from idea to outcome, and work alongside people who are smart, curious, and committed to doing great work.

We also give our teams access to AI tools and the encouragement to use them thoughtfully, to move faster, explore ideas, and build better ways of working.

We trust our teams to do their best work. That means autonomy, flexibility, and room to grow.

Come help us shape the future of travel.

jobs.description:
Job Description

We are currently seeking a Director, Oracle ERP Product Management to join our team.

The Director, Oracle ERP Product Management provides strategic and enterprise leadership for Oracle ERP, Financial Services applications (OFSAA) and related systems across the IT organization. Establishes the vision, strategy, governance, configuration standards, patterns, and operational practices to drive consistency, quality, security, scalability and operational excellence across teams and domains. The role is responsible for the technical product roadmap for Oracle ERP, aligning platform evolution to business strategy, regulatory expectations, technology architecture and operational reliability. Provides leadership and oversight for a portfolio of ERP initiatives, including major platform upgrades, integrations, modernization, sustainment, and emerging technology capabilities.

Here’s what would be included as a part of your typical day

Leadership: Provides leadership and direction for Oracle technology, product management, operations and support functions. Establishes long-term priorities and operating models that optimize service delivery in alignment with IT strategies, enterprise architecture, and business plans through DevOps practices, AI-driven operations, automation, streamlined processes, and well-defined service levels. Oversees workforce planning, professional development, performance management, and the development of critical ERP capabilities required to support current and future organizational needs.
ERP Configuration and Operational Standards: Establishes and governs enterprise-wide ERP configuration standards (configuration, scripting, testing, quality gates, documentation). Provides oversight to ensure IT teams and strategic partners consistently adopt high-quality SDLC processes, engineering practices, operational controls, and performance metrics. Establishes governance mechanisms to monitor adherence, manage exceptions, and drive continuous improvement across internal teams and outsourced development and support partners.
Oracle ERP and OSFAA Technical Product Management: Owns the technical product roadmap for Oracle ERP, including requirements governance, investment prioritization, platform evolution, vendor and partner planning, lifecycle management and technical debt. Provides strategic direction for major upgrades, integrations, and sustainment initiatives and guide solution option analyses, investment recommendations, and business cases to support enterprise technology decisions.
Delivery Leadership & Portfolio Execution: Manages portfolio of platform, module upgrades and application enhancements, ensuring delivery consistently reflects and reinforces best practices for high-quality, efficient execution. Oversees pilot implementations of new capabilities up to, and including, full scale rollouts. Oversees effective use of Generative AI tools for Oracle operations.
Team Support & Collaboration: Provides strategic leadership for the Oracle technology team and exercises significant influence across the organization to drive Oracle-related priorities and outcomes. Leads and guides cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, HR, Treasury, Risk, Technology, Security, Compliance, and the Business, establishing alignment and appropriate governance across competing priorities. Provides enterprise-level direction on Oracle priorities, including data and AI considerations, and aligns multiple stakeholders to operationalize the Oracle platform and achieve desired business outcomes.
Risk, Security & Compliance: Provide leadership and oversight for technology risk, security, regulatory compliance, and audit requirements across the Oracle ERP environment. Ensures product strategies, engineering standards, architecture, and operational practices incorporate identity, privacy, cybersecurity, resiliency, quality, change management, and appropriate risk controls. Maintains awareness of relevant regulatory guidelines, including OSFI and CDIC requirements affecting Oracle platforms and related business functions.
Relationship Building & Communication: Builds trusted relationships with senior IT and business leaders, Oracle, strategic technology partners, suppliers and industry groups. Communicates direction, standards, and technical decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Strategic and Technical Oversight: Provide oversight and guidance for ERP design, as-built, operational, architecture, and run documentation, ensuring consistency and alignment with enterprise standards.

Required Skills, Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in information technology or in a relevant field required.
8+ years progressive experience in ERP engineering, technology leadership and/or product management with significant experience in ERP, preferably Oracle and financial services.
Significant experience establishing ERP strategy, governance, engineering standards, and operational practices across multiple teams or technology domains.
Proven track record developing and executing ERP product strategies and roadmaps, leading complex integrations and major platform transformations, and managing strategic vendor relationships.
Demonstrated experience providing technology leadership within a complex, regulated operating environment.
Advanced communication and interpersonal skills to provide strategic advice, direction and guidance to senior business leaders, to establish alignment across complex stakeholder groups.
Advanced strategic thinking, analytical, problem‑solving, and decision‑making skills to evaluate complex technical environments.
Strong ability to influence platform, architecture, development, operations and delivery teams to adopt, establish and continuously improve engineering and product management practices.
Strong negotiation abilities to work effectively with Oracle, strategic technology partners, suppliers, and industry groups, acting as an influential organizational representative and technology leader.
Strong ability to lead through ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and make informed decisions involving material business, technology, operational, and risk considerations.
Expert knowledge of the concepts, theories, practices and techniques of the information technology field, with emphasis on ERP and technology, and related product management.
Expertise in ERP configuration, testing strategies, and ERP Management and Operations.
Advanced knowledge of the relevant regulatory requirements and other governing practices and principles.
Strong financial and business acumen to establish investment priorities, evaluate technology options, and align platform strategy with strategic organizational objectives.
Strong understanding of Generative AI, AI-driven operations, automation, and their responsible application across enterprise technology contexts.
Ability to translate complex technology concepts and risks into clear recommendations for senior and executive audiences.
Overnight travel may be occasionally required, up to 6 times per year
Displays an understanding of risk and risk ownership by being able to demonstrate adherence to policies and procedures.

About Us

What’s in it for you:

First, we strive to make our team members feel genuinely rewarded. You’ll have:

Mental health coverage and resources
Customizable health benefits, as well as topped-up parental leave
Performance-based compensation, employee banking advantages and group RRSP matching
Vacation time and flexible work arrangements to support your lifestyle

We are committed to providing a fair, equitable, and competitive rewards package that reflects the value an individual brings to our organization. The compensation mentioned in this job posting should serve as a guide. The total cash compensation earned may vary based on a variety of factors including bonuses and/or incentives, an individual’s skills and experience, and may correlate with performance in the role.

We also provide and encourage opportunities for our employees to make a meaningful impact. After all, as a credit union we’re powered by giving back—in big ways and through small gestures. That's why we offer employees paid time off to volunteer, partner with thousands of local charities, build long-lasting relationships that help our members get ahead and commit to environmental, social and governance (ESG) practices.

By joining our team, you’ll be able to elevate your potential. Wherever your own purpose leads, we’re here to support you with award-winning in-house training programs, access to LinkedIn Learning, and reimbursement for external courses to help you get ahead.

Take the next step in your career as part of our team. Apply for this opportunity!

Candidates, please note: if you are being considered for this role, you will be required to complete a background check, such as employment verification, credit check and criminal record check.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging

At Tru Cooperative Bank, we embrace diversity regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, race, ethnicity, age, diverse ability, and any aspect that makes someone unique. Inclusion is woven through our organization, from our employee-led network groups, hiring practices and education programs that address barriers and continually grow our equitable, diverse and inclusive culture.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Vice President, M&A Integration and Clinic Onboarding

Department: Operations

Scope: National – Canada

Reports to: Chief Growth Officer

Location: Toronto, Ontario (4 Days in Office, 1 Day Remote)

About 123Dentist

At 123Dentist, we are one of Canada’s largest and fastest-growing dental support organizations, supporting more than 500 clinics and 10,000 team members across the country. Growth through acquisition is central to that story, and our M&A Integration and Clinic Onboarding team makes sure every practice that joins the network is set up for success from day one.

Position Overview

123Dentist is seeking an accomplished executive to lead its national M&A Integration and Clinic Onboarding function. This leader will be responsible for bringing together the existing teams into a unified, scalable operation that ensures newly acquired dental practices transition successfully into the 123Dentist network, maintain operational continuity and deliver against acquisition objectives.

Reporting to our Chief Growth Officer, the Vice President M&A Integration and Clinic Onboarding will oversee the full integration lifecycle, from pre-close planning through operational stabilization and transition to Regional Operations. The role will also drive post-acquisition value creation in partnership with Finance and Operations, while ensuring a positive integration experience for partner dentists, clinic leaders and employees. Success will require strong commercial judgment, operational execution and the ability to lead cross-functional teams in a highly acquisitive, multi-site environment.

Key Accountabilities

Integration Strategy & Executive Leadership

Lead the national M&A Integration and Onboarding function, with accountability for its strategy, operating model, resources, priorities and overall performance.
Establish scalable integration processes, governance frameworks and standards that support multiple concurrent acquisitions across the network.
Exercise delegated decision-making authority over integration priorities, approved budgets and resources, ensuring alignment with organizational growth objectives.
Provide executive leadership with visibility into integration performance, material risks, resource requirements and strategic opportunities.

Acquisition Integration & Operational Readiness

Oversee the end-to-end operational integration of acquired practices, from permitted pre-close planning through Day 1 readiness, stabilization and formal operational handoff.
Establish acquisition-specific integration plans, milestones, accountabilities and risk mitigation strategies based on the complexity and needs of each practice.
Ensure effective coordination across clinic operations, HR, Finance, IT, Marketing, Procurement and other functions to maintain operational and patient care continuity.
Identify and resolve integration challenges, ensuring acquired clinics transition efficiently into the 123Dentist network.

Post-Acquisition Value Creation & Financial Performance

Lead the development and execution of post-acquisition value creation plans aligned with each acquisition’s investment case and the organization’s growth strategy.
Partner with Finance, Regional Operations and functional leaders to establish measurable revenue, growth, productivity and cost-efficiency initiatives.
Monitor integration-related financial and operational performance, identify variances and drive corrective actions with accountable business leaders.
Ensure financial value realization is appropriately tracked and validated by Finance, with ongoing performance accountability clearly transitioned to Regional Operations.

People, Culture & Partner Experience

Establish a consistent, relationship-focused onboarding experience for acquired practice owners, partner dentists, clinic leaders and employees.
Partner with HR and Regional Operations to identify and address critical talent retention risks, leadership transitions and workforce integration requirements.
Lead integration-related change management and communication efforts, promoting engagement, cultural alignment and trust throughout the transition.
Preserve strong local practice relationships while supporting the adoption of 123Dentist’s operating standards and organizational values.

Integration Governance & Operational Handoff

Establish cross-functional integration governance, including clear decision rights, accountabilities, milestones, escalation protocols and performance expectations.
Lead alignment among Corporate Development, Operations, Finance, HR, IT, Legal and other functions to ensure effective integration execution.
Establish formal integration completion and handoff criteria, ensuring operational readiness and clear ownership of outstanding risks and initiatives.
Partner with Regional Operations to ensure a seamless transition of accountability and sustainable clinic performance following integration.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead the consolidation of the existing M&A Integration and Clinic Onboarding teams into a unified national function.
Establish an effective organizational structure, clear leadership accountabilities and resource plans aligned with the acquisition strategy.
Build, coach and develop high-performing teams capable of managing multiple integrations and delivering measurable results.
Drive continuous improvement through standardized processes, performance reporting and scalable integration capabilities.

Qualifications & Experience

Significant progressive leadership experience in M&A integration, multi-site operations or operational transformation, ideally including 12–15 years of relevant experience.
Proven experience leading multiple acquisitions and integrating businesses within complex, geographically distributed organizations.
Demonstrated ability to build and lead integration teams, establish governance and deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.
Strong financial and commercial acumen, including investment-case execution, performance measurement and value realization.
Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior executives, operational leaders and key stakeholders.
Strong relationship management and change leadership capabilities, particularly when integrating acquired businesses and retaining critical talent.
Proven ability to balance strategic priorities with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, decentralized environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Finance or a related field; MBA or equivalent advanced qualification considered an asset.

Preferred Experience

Experience in highly acquisitive, multi-location organizations, including dental support organizations, veterinary networks, pharmacy, optometry, healthcare services or other decentralized service businesses. Experience in private equity-backed or high-growth acquisition environments is highly desirable.

What Sets You Apart

You thrive in a highly acquisitive, fast-paced, decentralized environment, balancing strategy with hands-on execution. You bring sound commercial judgment, lead cross-functional teams, influence senior executives, and build trust with partner dentists, clinic leaders and employees as practices join the network.

Why Join 123Dentist?

Lead a national function with real ownership, including delegated decision-making authority over integration priorities, budgets and resources
Build something new by bringing the existing M&A Integration and Clinic Onboarding teams together into one unified, scalable operation
Play a central role in the growth of one of Canada’s largest and fastest-growing dental support organizations
Partner with executive leadership, Finance and Regional Operations to turn each acquisition’s investment case into measurable results
Shape the experience of partner dentists, clinic leaders and employees as new practices join the network
